Joanna: Writer/screenwriter, also enjoys reading, dramas/romcoms, movies, hiking/nature, baking and DIY. Nature is a calming haven and inspires her writing. Writing and friends help her through hard times. She values Nate’s encouragement.

Joanna completed her first full drama/romance screenplay by 21 Jan 2022 and printed it on Friday, 21 Jan; planned to submit it to film festivals and seek producers/directors. She felt relief, excitement, anxiety, and later worried while awaiting responses. By 11 Nov she was filming her own movie based on the earlier road-trip script; an actress praised it on set, giving Joanna chills. She wrote a book draft, shared it with her writers’ group and got good feedback (Aug); finished writing it in early Oct. The book explores loss, redemption, forgiveness. Laptop crashed and destroyed all her work by 14 Sep; she bought an external backup drive. In childhood, at age 10, she wrote about a brave, scared turtle exploring the world. Her brother wrote her cute notes when they were children; one was included at the beginning of a script. Family photo on her inspiration corkboard reminds her of their love/support. She writes favorite memories in a notebook.

Took a research road trip to Woodhaven, a small Midwest town, in July; old buildings/library and a 1900s book of town stories/sketches inspired a new script. A sunset photo was taken hiking near Fort Wayne the previous summer. Likes cozy movie nights: fluffy multi-person couch, weighted blanket, dimmable lights. Favorite genres dramas/romcoms, emotionally driven films; recommended “Little Women” to Nate (he watched it by Oct 2022) and a romantic drama about memory/relationships shown in a poster of a man and woman on a bench (title not stated). He finds them calming, low-maintenance; feeds vegetables, fruit, insects, keeps enclosure clean/lighted. Likes watching them eat fruit; often shares photos.
